Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 30, "heading": "CHAPTER 28. Mr. MICAWBER’S GAUNTLET", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u030-b0123", "target": "— Да ведь это, Маргаритка, ужин для короля! — воскликнул он, вдруг прервав молчание и садясь за стол. — Я отдам ему должное, потому что приехал из Ярмута.", "source_sha256": "c002cacb1ef531a6babe33c1e45d2e7be369a04714fb2085a4d14c1e2b3b754a", "target_id": "ru-en85-u030-b0123", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ad7676093609f1cbdb341fbee222c87b9a218ae0e4b1f4883cb626b55cb55909"}, {"source_id": "en85-u030-b0124", "target": "— А я думал, ты приехал из Оксфорда? — отозвался я.", "source_sha256": "855fef02de28f22d6b45043b234776e8469adb580a685f5db5cb58202101b78d", "target_id": "ru-en85-u030-b0124", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "01bdb19a158f351fa0c30fe47b387b8c80448e6aba5937f27905ac899ac9e5a8"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 28, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u030-b0125", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not I,’ said Steerforth. ‘I have been seafaring—better employed.’", "sha256": "2e028d43347d3484e4d2641588ed4cac2e37589c66645956667d9984cbf0e59f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[126]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0126", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Littimer was here today, to inquire for you,’ I remarked, ‘and I understood him that you were at Oxford; though, now I think of it, he certainly did not say so.’", "sha256": "1d4ac9e6dbd6eeb05ee9178a1005277cc9a4cfad1921530e437c9cb01187ae84", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[127]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0127", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Littimer is a greater fool than I thought him, to have been inquiring for me at all,’ said Steerforth, jovially pouring out a glass of wine, and drinking to me. ‘As to understanding him, you are a cleverer fellow than most of us, Daisy, if you can do that.’", "sha256": "7eec194d8d474a2b35f1b33bc675be948f6e36d5377fe1b29ab9948564de9234", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[128]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0128", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s true, indeed,’ said I, moving my chair to the table. ‘So you have been at Yarmouth, Steerforth!’ interested to know all about it. ‘Have you been there long?’", "sha256": "cdce49dad3420799219d37bc0154d9d1ad8ae9254e938f8c26707102122a4532", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[129]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0129", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ he returned. ‘An escapade of a week or so.’", "sha256": "ac9e132902b43e0063a45de2aaf955aceaa32685947c6d2d293498cb632b0464", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[130]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0130", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And how are they all? Of course, little Emily is not married yet?’", "sha256": "f4cd2e9ce6f96fb90bba3eccaccd204803a4bcfece71a0267d4fa535178f0726", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[131]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0131", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not yet. Going to be, I believe—in so many weeks, or months, or something or other. I have not seen much of ‘em. By the by’; he laid down his knife and fork, which he had been using with great diligence, and began feeling in his pockets; ‘I have a letter for you.’", "sha256": "1d7da3b44ae03c3c24f2d7132bd613c363d8a5875f6ffc6e68b66567d9e44b29", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[132]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0132", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘From whom?’", "sha256": "051bd6043864a987a0c5e8a2945d722e54fd8a26594f440c1996ab17dbb74ed6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[133]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0133", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, from your old nurse,’ he returned, taking some papers out of his breast pocket. “‘J. Steerforth, Esquire, debtor, to The Willing Mind”; that’s not it. Patience, and we’ll find it presently. Old what’s-his-name’s in a bad way, and it’s about that, I believe.’", "sha256": "aa8d2f885fb1458c78876f683106de38729433904adbbe72cfe4b0c16f76a663", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[134]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0134", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Barkis, do you mean?’", "sha256": "edd2cf2bb62589e2c1ebf8d4d802babdc40a413a0d0930350c339be89311e90f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[135]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0135", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes!’ still feeling in his pockets, and looking over their contents: ‘it’s all over with poor Barkis, I am afraid. I saw a little apothecary there—surgeon, or whatever he is—who brought your worship into the world. He was mighty learned about the case, to me; but the upshot of his opinion was, that the carrier was making his last journey rather fast.—-Put your hand into the breast pocket of my great-coat on the chair yonder, and I think you’ll find the letter. Is it there?’", "sha256": "6ee002fb6effcd5ba8c4058fd73d2ecea79f33fc8844397414519ef879764daa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[136]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0136", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Here it is!’ said I.", "sha256": "e2f0abf23687e97050d3af72f9e7e47c58c344a3361ebdf9e7974eeb3c3a3df3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s right!’", "sha256": "d9b05c0b6b6451db438d855dee32dff1d79c84deb1631f97ebf7e30566b18c0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[138]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0138", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was from Peggotty; something less legible than usual, and brief. It informed me of her husband’s hopeless state, and hinted at his being ‘a little nearer’ than heretofore, and consequently more difficult to manage for his own comfort. It said nothing of her weariness and watching, and praised him highly. It was written with a plain, unaffected, homely piety that I knew to be genuine, and ended with ‘my duty to my ever darling’—meaning myself.", "sha256": "853e9269d4ca1efa82b46afab3f2c925f63fb3f3abdafe5fe0156c2810136383", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "While I deciphered it, Steerforth continued to eat and drink.", "sha256": "a0f78a606004ba2838bd01fa11d14edf1f276c2dce3a4f3ff0e21d35d7c3a3bd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[140]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0140", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘It’s a bad job,’ he said, when I had done; ‘but the sun sets every day, and people die every minute, and we mustn’t be scared by the common lot. If we failed to hold our own, because that equal foot at all men’s doors was heard knocking somewhere, every object in this world would slip from us. No! Ride on! Rough-shod if need be, smooth-shod if that will do, but ride on! Ride on over all obstacles, and win the race!’", "sha256": "bea57801756e5d6321b9d00974ac091786f6f09c1bb76aee24beae39b267921b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[141]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0141", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And win what race?’ said I.", "sha256": "a571a64f60d47c15f059487a6e3ae667456d2c6b3debb1077a26337d0942da80", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[142]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0142", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The race that one has started in,’ said he. ‘Ride on!’", "sha256": "1c930aabc7d1554ac98e971693b399f1ed850d34a5386d04605b55bafdc6a703", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[143]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0143", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I noticed, I remember, as he paused, looking at me with his handsome head a little thrown back, and his glass raised in his hand, that, though the freshness of the sea-wind was on his face, and it was ruddy, there were traces in it, made since I last saw it, as if he had applied himself to some habitual strain of the fervent energy which, when roused, was so passionately roused within him. I had it in my thoughts to remonstrate with him upon his desperate way of pursuing any fancy that he took—such as this buffeting of rough seas, and braving of hard weather, for example—when my mind glanced off to the immediate subject of our conversation again, and pursued that instead.", "sha256": "b693c136988bea57d36185dbcdd4d070b00341b60d48ed70b146baf2edfd9a11", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[144]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0144", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I tell you what, Steerforth,’ said I, ‘if your high spirits will listen to me—’", "sha256": "0070a2c916b426219b460b9e7b98eaa11395146cdf2b53cefb617c3a9e664e5b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[145]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0145", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘They are potent spirits, and will do whatever you like,’ he answered, moving from the table to the fireside again.", "sha256": "5fe839226c2eb42a3bb5480cb043424374e2655f50c0e86691a51ceb91d904ac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[146]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0146", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then I tell you what, Steerforth. I think I will go down and see my old nurse. It is not that I can do her any good, or render her any real service; but she is so attached to me that my visit will have as much effect on her, as if I could do both. She will take it so kindly that it will be a comfort and support to her. It is no great effort to make, I am sure, for such a friend as she has been to me. Wouldn’t you go a day’s journey, if you were in my place?’", "sha256": "42f539617860f8f2576da3ac7399ff15fad7d61c47b9f834854e14c3f0a100ef", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[147]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0147", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "His face was thoughtful, and he sat considering a little before he answered, in a low voice, ‘Well! Go. You can do no harm.’", "sha256": "7abca81434e08351ce18d14be35b21e340c9c17e1010931e82a473d7e2abffad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[148]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0148", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You have just come back,’ said I, ‘and it would be in vain to ask you to go with me?’", "sha256": "1ae2056c56f67b35d01461d9fc60f6608f4e452f7029ccea19d4f2a01383c0f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[149]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0149", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Quite,’ he returned. ‘I am for Highgate tonight. I have not seen my mother this long time, and it lies upon my conscience, for it’s something to be loved as she loves her prodigal son.—-Bah! Nonsense!—You mean to go tomorrow, I suppose?’ he said, holding me out at arm’s length, with a hand on each of my shoulders.", "sha256": "7c81756fa5a362dd3dcadfd9b689a135e158ef2ad1cc4b4ff542a3ee74891af6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[150]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0150", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, I think so.’", "sha256": "136c809ab115fa3e51851122ee04dad7237201cec1b889d42ad091ea9e7369b3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[151]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0151", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, then, don’t go till next day. I wanted you to come and stay a few days with us. Here I am, on purpose to bid you, and you fly off to Yarmouth!’", "sha256": "2b99ffa415a7b18549542015619456dc4a0fe933ff8a456b0fc1b151094daaac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[152]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0152", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You are a nice fellow to talk of flying off, Steerforth, who are always running wild on some unknown expedition or other!’", "sha256": "900b92b44617dfa0d1d0905dcd3f0a0f8bd4dc62d376d0b0a386de11b60ab584", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[153]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0153", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He looked at me for a moment without speaking, and then rejoined, still holding me as before, and giving me a shake:", "sha256": "65fe867f058a9e6c3a2370a759832e667cc1bf20b09e6ccb7e226d504ad13bf1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[154]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0154", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Come! Say the next day, and pass as much of tomorrow as you can with us! Who knows when we may meet again, else? Come! Say the next day! I want you to stand between Rosa Dartle and me, and keep us asunder.’", "sha256": "8e32282f6d72070f0ea9ea6a7493409c14db5594fcde4eaba2ef02ef321d2981", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[155]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0155", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Would you love each other too much, without me?’", "sha256": "feba2d644be842e88ca4517ed6f72989c04dd674bd3c71d8827412a64116624d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[156]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0156", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes; or hate,’ laughed Steerforth; ‘no matter which. Come! Say the next day!’", "sha256": "6dd7cb8941defd3d3e7b64a6f8af3d3714e4099b2a42d838a2bf9b2267164684", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[157]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
